title: Derive recipe corpus instruction helpers from opcode metadata
body: The hand-written RecipeParityCorpus helpers for ReadParamU32 and ReadParamQ16 set paramMask=1 even though RecipeRegistry and the GLSL emitter allow nonzero masks only for ReadParam and ReadParamFloat3. The typed-read mask contract is duplicated across handwritten helper code and validation logic; generate or centralize typed instruction construction from opcode metadata so test tapes cannot drift from the registry contract.

title: Isolate editor capture writes from tracked sample documents
body: The queued ctest --test-dir build/wsl --output-on-failure -j8 -L 'RenderGraph|SVO' ran vixen_editor_capture_producer, which changed the tracked VIXEN/BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.edited.vxd from 588 to 916 bytes even though the test passed. I had to restore that source asset after the witness to leave the lane clean. Run the producer against a worktree-local temporary copy or direct its document saves to the capture runtime directory.
